newsitem.title: USA: Ruby Tuesday tenders for 1 mln of its shares.
newsitem.headline: Ruby Tuesday tenders for 1 mln of its shares.

text.p: Restaurant chain Ruby Tuesday Inc said Thursday it will begin a "Dutch auction" tender offer for up to 1.0 million of its common shares or about 5.7 percent of its current outstanding shares.
Under terms of the offer, the company said it will invite shareholders to tender their shares at prices specified by the tendering shareholders within a range of $20.00 to $22.00 per share.
The tender offer will begin May 2 and will expire June 2, unless extended, the company said.

Based upon the number of shares tendered and the prices specified by the tendering shareholders, the company will select a single per-share purchase price within the $20-$22 range, which will be paid for shares tendered at or below that price.

If the offer were oversubscribed, shares would be purchased first from shareholders owning fewer than 100 shares and tendering all of their shares at or below the purchase price. The company would then purchase shares from other shareholders who tendered at or below the purchase price, on a pro rata basis.
The company said it reserves the right to buy more than 1.0 million. The offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of shares being tendered, it said.
The company said its board is not making any recommendation as to whether shareholders should tender any shares in the offer.
It named Wheat First Butcher Singer as dealer-manager and D.F. King & Co Inc as information agent.
